title: Graph-Spectral Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.36765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multivariate time series anomaly detection typically relies on evaluating discrepancies between observations and outputs produced by models trained on normal data. An alternative perspective is to characterize the distribution of normal data through the generative dynamics, i.e., the velocity field, of flow matching models. However, standard flow matching typically adopts linear probability paths that overlook dependencies among variables, leading to a misalignment with the structured data distribution. To address this issue, we propose GRASP, a flow matching framework with a graph-spectral path for multivariate time series anomaly detection. GRASP incorporates graph structure into the probability path by minimizing a fixed-endpoint action that combines kinetic energy with graph Dirichlet energy. This formulation yields a closed-form path based on graph-frequency-dependent hyperbolic interpolation. A velocity predictor trained on normal

translated_title: 基于图谱流匹配的多变量时间序列异常检测
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列异常检测通常依赖于评估观测数据与在正常数据上训练的模型所产生输出之间的差异。另一种替代视角是通过流匹配模型的生成动力学（即速度场）来刻画正常数据的分布。然而，标准的流匹配通常采用线性概率路径，忽略了变量之间的依赖关系，导致与结构化数据分布的不匹配。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GRASP，一个具有图谱路径的流匹配框架，用于多变量时间序列异常检测。GRASP通过最小化一个结合了动能与图狄利克雷能量的固定端点作用量，将图结构融入概率路径中。该公式化得到了基于图频率相关双曲插值的闭式路径。在正常数据上训练的速度预测器……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出GRASP框架，通过最小化结合动能与图狄利克雷能量的作用量，构建基于图谱频率双曲插值的概率路径，从而在流匹配中引入变量间的依赖关系，提升多变量时间序列异常检测性能。
en_tdlr: We propose GRASP, a flow matching framework that incorporates graph structure into the probability path via a graph-spectral, hyperbolic interpolation route, better capturing inter-variable dependencies for multivariate time series anomaly detection.
